description: Four function generators, each slewing towards its input voltage at its own rise and fall times, with a curve control, a manual trigger and a looping switch

params.text: Sets the time range of that channel: medium from 0.01 to 10 seconds, fast from 1ms to 1 second, or slow from 0.1 to 102 seconds
Starts that channel's envelope by hand, taking it to 10V and then letting it fall
Switches looping on and off for that channel, one press on and the next off
Bends both slopes of that channel, logarithmic anticlockwise, straight at noon and exponential clockwise
Sets how long that channel takes to rise, from the shortest time of its range at the bottom to a thousand times that at the top
Sets how long that channel takes to fall, from the shortest time of its range at the bottom to a thousand times that at the top

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2V starts that channel's envelope, taking it to 10V and then letting it fall
A rising edge switches looping on or off for that channel
Adds to the rise time of that channel, 10V covering the whole of the range
Adds to the fall time of that channel, 10V covering the whole of the range
The voltage that channel slews towards

outputs.text: The slewed output of that channel

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
